title: 容量仪器与移液器
source_doc: course/高校实验室安全/165_容量仪器与移液器.md
author_source: project/高校实验室安全/165_容量仪器与移液器/src.py

shots.scene: 欣欣站在量筒、移液管、容量瓶和移液器前
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands behind a graduated cylinder, a glass pipette, a volumetric flask and a micropipette on a bench, looking at the camera.
shots.narration: 第15章第三课：容量仪器与移液器。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着一个空白标签的试剂瓶
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a reagent bottle with a blank label and a tick icon.
shots.narration: 量得准，实验结果才可靠。

shots.scene: 阿杰用烧杯量取溶液配标准溶液
shots.prompt_en: The young male student measures liquid with a beaker and pours it into a volumetric flask, looking unsure.
shots.narration: 阿杰拿烧杯量体积，配标准溶液。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿起移液管想用嘴吸
shots.prompt_en: The young male student lifts a glass pipette toward his mouth, a red stop icon appears beside him.
shots.narration: 又拿起移液管，想用嘴吸。

shots.scene: 小研递给他洗耳球
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stops him and hands him a rubber pipette bulb, pointing at the pipette.
shots.narration: 小研：严禁用嘴吸！量器要用对。

shots.scene: 做菜和做实验对比
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cooking pot with a spoon of spice on one side, a flask with a precise drop on the other side. No text.
shots.narration: 做菜多放点没关系，实验可不行。

shots.scene: 宽口烧杯：读错一点差很多
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a wide beaker and a narrow cylinder, the same small height error shown as a big volume slice in the beaker. No text.
shots.narration: 烧杯锥形瓶口宽，刻度只是大概。

shots.scene: 量筒细、刻度密
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a slim graduated cylinder with dense graduation marks and a check mark, a tiny volume with a question mark. No text.
shots.narration: 量筒准得多，但量很少的液体不够准。

shots.scene: 容量瓶一条刻线，一个体积
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a volumetric flask with a single ring mark, a one icon beside it. No text.
shots.narration: 容量瓶准，但一只瓶只量一个体积。

shots.scene: 移液器具：从微升到几十毫升
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a micropipette, a glass pipette and an electric pipette controller in a row with a scale from tiny to large. No text.
shots.narration: 又准又灵活，就用移液器具。

shots.scene: 仪器干净，刻度清楚
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a clean pipette with clear marks beside a dirty one with droplets clinging to the wall. No text.
shots.narration: 量器保持清洁，刻度才看得清。

shots.scene: 【实拍】视线与刻线平齐，读凹液面最低处
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: an eye level with a graduation mark on a cylinder of colored water, the bottom of the curved surface touching the mark.
shots.narration: 视线和液面平齐，读凹液面最低处。

shots.scene: 从上看、从下看都偏
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three eyes looking from above, level and below at a liquid surface, only the level one checked. No text.
shots.narration: 从上或从下看，读数都会偏。

shots.scene: 滴定管也要平视
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an eye level with the meniscus in a burette, a dashed horizontal sight line. No text.
shots.narration: 读滴定管，一样要平视。

shots.scene: 移液管：负压把液体吸上来
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a glass pipette with a rubber bulb on top, arrows showing liquid rising by suction. No text.
shots.narration: 移液管靠吸球的负压吸液。

shots.scene: 【实拍】手握移液管靠近上端，轻轻旋入洗耳球
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: one hand holds a glass pipette close to its top end and gently twists it into the tip of a rubber bulb.
shots.narration: 握近上端，轻轻旋进去，别硬塞。

shots.scene: 握得太远硬塞，折断扎手
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand holding a pipette far from the top and forcing it into a bulb, the pipette snapping, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 握得远、用力猛，会折断割伤手。

shots.scene: 捏扁吸耳球，插入液体，慢慢松开
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a squeezed rubber bulb on a pipette dipped into liquid, then slowly released as liquid rises to the mark. No text.
shots.narration: 捏扁排气，插入液体，慢慢松开。

shots.scene: 【实拍】三阀吸球：排气、吸液、放液
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: fingers press the top valve of a three-valve pipette filler to flatten it, press the lower valve to draw colored water, then the side valve to release it.
shots.narration: 三阀吸球：排气、吸液、放液各一阀。

shots.scene: 移液泵、电动移液器
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a thumbwheel pipette pump and an electric pipette controller with check marks. No text.
shots.narration: 要更平稳，可用移液泵。

shots.scene: 吸过零刻度润洗，弃去
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a pipette drawing liquid above the zero mark, tilted and rotated to wet its wall, then drained into a waste beaker. No text.
shots.narration: 先吸过零刻度润洗，润洗液放掉。

shots.scene: 【实拍】尖嘴靠瓶内壁，慢慢放液到零刻度
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a pipette tip touching the inner wall of a beaker, the meniscus lowered slowly to the zero mark at eye level.
shots.narration: 再吸过零刻度，慢慢放到零刻度。

shots.scene: 液体冲进吸球，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: liquid shooting up into a rubber bulb, crossed out, an eye watching the rising liquid with a check mark. No text.
shots.narration: 吸液要慢盯住液面，别吸进吸球。

shots.scene: 放液靠壁停留，尖嘴残液不吹
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a pipette draining against the wall of a receiving flask, a small drop left in the tip with a check mark. No text.
shots.narration: 放液靠壁停一会，残液按标识处理。

shots.scene: 清洗移液管，吸球保持干燥
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a pipette rinsed at a sink, a dry rubber bulb set aside away from water. No text.
shots.narration: 移液管照常清洗，吸球不能进水。

shots.scene: 电动移液器：按键吸放
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an electric pipette controller with an up button and a down button, a pipette drawing liquid. No text.
shots.narration: 量一毫升以上、反复量，用电动移液器。

shots.scene: 吸管插紧
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a serological pipette pushed firmly into the nosepiece of an electric pipette controller. No text.
shots.narration: 吸管插紧，上键吸，下键排。

shots.scene: 吸过头，滤膜湿了
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: liquid overshooting into the nosepiece and wetting a small filter disc, a warning mark. No text.
shots.narration: 吸过头，滤膜一湿就不工作了。

shots.scene: 换专用空气滤膜，针头滤器打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a new air filter disc fitted in the correct direction, a syringe filter crossed out, an arrow to a teacher icon. No text.
shots.narration: 换专用滤膜，按方向装，仍坏就报告。

shots.scene: 一次性塑料滴管转移少量液体
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a disposable plastic dropper with faint graduation marks transferring a little liquid. No text.
shots.narration: 量很少的液体，用一次性塑料滴管。

shots.scene: 不能碰塑料的液体用玻璃滴管
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a glass dropper with a rubber bulb adding drops one by one into a flask, a plastic dropper crossed out beside a solvent bottle. No text.
shots.narration: 不能碰塑料的，用玻璃滴管逐滴加。

shots.scene: 二十滴约一毫升，只是估计
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a dropper with twenty drops falling into a small cylinder, an approximately-equal icon. No text.
shots.narration: 二十滴大约一毫升，只能估计。

shots.scene: 玻璃滴管洗净收好
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a glass dropper rinsed and placed in a rack, a broken dropper going into a broken glass box. No text.
shots.narration: 玻璃滴管用完洗净，破了放碎玻璃盒。

shots.scene: 标准溶液：浓度准确已知
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a bottle of solution with a precise concentration icon, an arrow to an unknown sample with a question mark. No text.
shots.narration: 标准溶液，浓度准确已知。

shots.scene: 基准物质在天平上称量
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: white primary standard crystals weighed on an analytical balance. No text.
shots.narration: 称好基准物质，比如酸碱滴定用的。

shots.scene: 按摩尔质量计算
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a mass icon divided by a molar mass icon equals an amount, then divided by a flask volume. No text.
shots.narration: 按摩尔质量，算出物质的量和浓度。

shots.scene: 烧杯里加水搅拌溶解
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: weighed crystals in a beaker with water and a stir bar spinning. No text.
shots.narration: 倒进烧杯，加少量水搅拌溶解。

shots.scene: 备好容量瓶、漏斗、玻璃棒、洗瓶、滴管，旁边是称好的固体和浓溶液
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a volumetric flask, a funnel, a glass rod, a wash bottle and a dropper laid out on a bench, beside a dish of weighed crystals and a small bottle of concentrated solution. No text.
shots.narration: 备好漏斗玻璃棒，固体浓溶液都能配。

shots.scene: 【实拍】玻璃棒引流，经漏斗倒入容量瓶
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: colored water poured from a beaker along a glass rod through a funnel into a volumetric flask.
shots.narration: 沿玻璃棒，经漏斗慢慢倒进容量瓶。

shots.scene: 【实拍】洗瓶冲洗烧杯、玻璃棒、漏斗
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a wash bottle rinsing the beaker, the glass rod and the funnel, the rinse flowing into the flask.
shots.narration: 烧杯、玻璃棒、漏斗各冲三次，并入。

shots.scene: 加到半瓶，摇动助溶
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a volumetric flask half full being swirled, undissolved crystals at the bottom. No text.
shots.narration: 加到半瓶，摇一摇，帮助溶解。

shots.scene: 看瓶底，溶完再加水
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a magnifier at the bottom of a flask showing no crystals left, a check mark. No text.
shots.narration: 看瓶底溶完了，再加水到刻线下。

shots.scene: 静置让瓶颈液体流下
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: liquid droplets running down the inner neck of a volumetric flask below the mark, a clock icon. No text.
shots.narration: 静置一会，让瓶颈上的液体流下。

shots.scene: 【实拍】滴管逐滴加水，凹液面最低处与刻线相切
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: at eye level, a dropper adds water drop by drop until the bottom of the meniscus just touches the ring mark on the flask neck.
shots.narration: 滴管逐滴加，凹液面与刻线相切。

shots.scene: 【实拍】盖紧塞子，按住塞子颠倒多次
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a hand holds the stopper of a volumetric flask with one finger while inverting the flask several times.
shots.narration: 按住塞子，颠倒多次摇匀。

shots.scene: 转入干燥储液瓶，贴标签
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the solution poured into a clean dry storage bottle, a blank label being attached, the cap tightened. No text.
shots.narration: 转入储液瓶，贴标签、盖紧。

shots.scene: 容量瓶洗净倒置晾干
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a washed volumetric flask clamped upside down on a drying rack. No text.
shots.narration: 容量瓶洗净，倒置夹好晾干。

shots.scene: 滴定管精确滴加
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a burette above a conical flask dripping slowly, a stopcock at the bottom. No text.
shots.narration: 滴定管能精确地一点点滴加。

shots.scene: 【实拍】手从后面环握活塞，食指中指控制
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a hand wraps around a burette stopcock from behind, the index finger and middle finger gently turning it.
shots.narration: 手从后面环握活塞，轻推控制流速。

shots.scene: 少量滴定液润洗内壁
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a tilted burette rotated so a little liquid wets the whole inner wall, then drained into waste. No text.
shots.narration: 先用少量滴定液润洗，再装过零刻度。

shots.scene: 【实拍】快速转动活塞排出尖嘴气泡
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: an air bubble in a burette tip pushed out by quickly opening and closing the stopcock over a waste beaker.
shots.narration: 尖嘴有气泡，快速开关活塞排掉。

shots.scene: 记下初读数
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a burette meniscus near the zero mark, a notebook with a pencil writing. No text.
shots.narration: 不必正好是零，先记下初读数。

shots.scene: 长柄刷清洗滴定管
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a long-handled brush cleaning inside a burette, water running through the tip. No text.
shots.narration: 长柄刷清洗，尖嘴也要冲到。

shots.scene: 注射器转移极少量液体
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a glass syringe drawing a little more liquid than needed from a sealed vial. No text.
shots.narration: 极少量液体，用注射器，多吸一点。

shots.scene: 【实拍】轻弹针筒让气泡上升排出
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a finger flicks a syringe barrel filled with water held tip up, bubbles rising and pushed out with the extra liquid into a beaker.
shots.narration: 轻弹针筒，气泡升到顶，连多余推出。

shots.scene: 抽一段空气垫再转移
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a syringe with a small air gap between the liquid and the needle tip, an arrow to a receiving flask. No text.
shots.narration: 抽一小段空气垫，再转移。

shots.scene: 针头里残液排净
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a syringe turned up, plunger pulled slightly and pushed again to clear the last drop from the needle. No text.
shots.narration: 针头里还有残液，抽一抽再推净。

shots.scene: 拆开清洗，针头进锐器盒
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a syringe taken apart into barrel, plunger and needle, the needle placed into a sharps container without recapping. No text.
shots.narration: 拆开分别清洗，针头别回套。

shots.scene: 一毫升以下用自动移液器
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a glass pipette with a question mark for a tiny volume, a micropipette with a check mark. No text.
shots.narration: 一毫升以下，常用自动移液器。

shots.scene: 活塞推出空气，松开吸液
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cutaway micropipette showing a piston pushing air out, then rising to draw liquid into the tip. No text.
shots.narration: 按下推出空气，松开吸进液体。

shots.scene: 准确度与精密度
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two target boards, one with hits clustered on the center, one with hits clustered off center. No text.
shots.narration: 准：接近设定值；精：每次都一样。

shots.scene: 认识各部件
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a micropipette with a plunger button, a tip ejector button, an adjustment knob, a display window and a shaft, arrows pointing to each. No text.
shots.narration: 按钮、退头钮、旋钮、显示窗、吸杆。

shots.scene: 按钮上标着最大量程
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: several micropipettes of different sizes, a magnifier on the top of a plunger button showing a number icon. No text.
shots.narration: 规格看按钮，标的是最大量程。

shots.scene: 量程低端误差大
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a volume range bar with the low end shaded red and a recommended zone shaded green. No text.
shots.narration: 量程低端误差大，不推荐使用。

shots.scene: 两支都够，选小规格
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a target volume fitting both a medium and a large micropipette, the medium one checked. No text.
shots.narration: 两支都够用，选较小规格那支。

shots.scene: 旋过最大量程，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a knob turned past the top of the range with a broken gear icon, crossed out, an arrow to a larger pipette. No text.
shots.narration: 别转过最大量程，超了换大规格。

shots.scene: 读显示窗，看清位数
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a micropipette display window with blank digit boxes and a magnifier, a manual book icon. No text.
shots.narration: 读显示窗要看清位数，按说明书读。

shots.scene: 【实拍】先旋过目标值约三分之一圈，再慢慢回调
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: fingers turn a micropipette adjustment knob slightly past the target value, then slowly back down to it.
shots.narration: 先转过目标值，再慢慢回调。

shots.scene: 总是从大往小调
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a downward arrow on a dial with gear teeth meshing, a check mark. No text.
shots.narration: 总从大往小调，消除机械回差。

shots.scene: 备好吸头、架子、新容器、擦拭纸和废物盒
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a micropipette stand, a box of tips, a new tube rack, lab tissues and a waste box arranged on a bench. No text.
shots.narration: 备好吸头、架子、容器和废物盒。

shots.scene: 吸头规格与移液器配对
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three tip sizes in different colors each matched to a micropipette size by arrows. No text.
shots.narration: 吸头规格要配对，才不漏、才准。

shots.scene: 【实拍】吸杆压进吸头，轻轻一转装紧
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a micropipette shaft pressed into a tip in an open tip box and given a slight twist to seal.
shots.narration: 吸杆压进吸头，轻轻一转装紧。

shots.scene: 吸头松了，换合适的
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a loose tip wobbling on the shaft with a drip, crossed out, a fitting tip checked. No text.
shots.narration: 装不紧会漏，换合适的吸头。

shots.scene: 每个样品换新吸头
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two sample tubes, a used tip discarded between them, a new tip for the second tube. No text.
shots.narration: 一样一换，吸头只碰样品。

shots.scene: 按到有阻力处是第一档
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a thumb pressing a plunger to the first point of resistance, a number one icon. No text.
shots.narration: 按到有阻力的地方，就是第一档。

shots.scene: 【实拍】竖直持握，吸头浸入液面下几毫米，慢慢松开
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a micropipette held vertically, the tip just a few millimeters below the surface of colored water, the thumb slowly releasing.
shots.narration: 竖直拿，浸入几毫米，慢慢松开。

shots.scene: 浸太深、太浅都不对
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a tip plunged too deep with liquid on its outside and a tip too shallow sucking air bubbles, both crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 浸太深挂液进吸杆，太浅吸进空气。

shots.scene: 停一两秒再取出
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a tip held in the liquid with a short clock icon, more time for a thick liquid. No text.
shots.narration: 松开后停一两秒，粘稠的多等会儿。

shots.scene: 新吸头先预润洗
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a new tip drawing and expelling liquid once back into the source tube, a thin film on the inner wall. No text.
shots.narration: 新吸头先吸排一次，预润洗。

shots.scene: 按钮弹回、吸进气泡，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a thumb letting the plunger snap back and bubbles in the tip, crossed out, an arrow to a waste cup. No text.
shots.narration: 按钮慢慢松；有气泡排掉重吸。

shots.scene: 擦吸头外壁，别碰吸头口
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a lab tissue wiping the outside of a filled tip, the tissue kept away from the opening. No text.
shots.narration: 擦掉外壁液体，别碰吸头口。

shots.scene: 【实拍】吸头贴内壁，按到第一档停几秒，再按到第二档
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a filled tip touching the inner wall of a tube, the thumb pressing to the first stop, pausing, then pressing further to the second stop.
shots.narration: 贴壁按到一档停几秒，再按到二档。

shots.scene: 按住沿壁滑出再松手
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a pipette tip sliding up along the tube wall while the plunger stays pressed, then the thumb released. No text.
shots.narration: 按住别松，沿壁滑出再松手。

shots.scene: 【实拍】按退吸头钮，吸头落入废物盒
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a thumb presses the tip ejector and the used tip drops into a waste box.
shots.narration: 按退头钮，吸头弹进废物盒。

shots.scene: 手套取下吸头也可
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a gloved hand pulling off a tip when the ejector does not work, the tip placed in the waste box. No text.
shots.narration: 退头钮坏了，戴手套取下。

shots.scene: 带液时倾斜不超过二十度
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a micropipette with a filled tip tilted slightly within a small angle arc, a flat-lying pipette crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 带液时倾斜别超过二十度，不平放。

shots.scene: 用完竖直挂回支架
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: micropipettes hanging vertically on a stand, one lying on the bench crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 用完竖直挂回支架。

shots.scene: 按放速度力度、深度角度都一致
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a row of identical thumb icons and identical angle icons, an equal sign. No text.
shots.narration: 速度、力度、深度、角度，每次一样。

shots.scene: 过冷过热样品、腐蚀液
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an ice icon and a flame icon next to a pipette with a question mark, a corrosion pictogram near a seal ring. No text.
shots.narration: 太冷太热不准，腐蚀液会伤活塞。

shots.scene: 移过腐蚀液立即清洗，别摔
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a micropipette taken apart for cleaning after use with a corrosive, a falling pipette crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 移过腐蚀液马上清洗，精密件别摔。

shots.scene: 【实拍】天平上去皮，用移液器移水称重
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a small beaker on an analytical balance tared, a micropipette dispensing water into it, the display changing.
shots.narration: 称水检验：水的体积可换成质量。

shots.scene: 量程上下两端各称多次
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: six repeat weighings at the top of the range and six at the bottom, an average and spread icon. No text.
shots.narration: 上下两端各称几次，算平均和偏差。

shots.scene: 吸液竖直等候，看是否漏滴
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a filled tip held vertically with a clock icon, a drop forming at the tip with a warning mark. No text.
shots.narration: 吸液竖直等一会，冒液滴就是漏了。

shots.scene: 偏差大，停用送校准
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a micropipette with a stop tag, an arrow to a teacher icon and a calibration service icon. No text.
shots.narration: 偏差大或漏液，停用报告，送校准。

shots.scene: 量取腐蚀、挥发性试剂在通风柜里
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a student wearing goggles, gloves and a lab coat pipetting inside a fume hood. No text.
shots.narration: 腐蚀性挥发性试剂，在通风柜里量。

shots.scene: 先看安全说明
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a safety data sheet beside a reagent bottle with hazard pictograms. No text.
shots.narration: 先看安全说明，了解危害。

shots.scene: 破损移液管用工具清理
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: tongs picking up a broken pipette into a broken glass box, a bare hand crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 用后及时洗净，破了用工具清理。

shots.scene: 量筒、移液管、滴定管、容量瓶
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cylinder, a pipette, a burette and a volumetric flask with an eye at the level of each meniscus. No text.
shots.narration: 选对量器，平视读凹液面最低处。

shots.scene: 洗耳球、定容摇匀、贴标签
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a rubber bulb with a check mark, a mouth crossed out, a flask being inverted and a labeled bottle. No text.
shots.narration: 严禁嘴吸，定容后摇匀、贴标签。

shots.scene: 移液器量程、一档二档、校准
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a micropipette with a range bar, a one and two stop icon and a balance icon. No text.
shots.narration: 移液器选对量程，一档吸二档排。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在滴定管旁
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a burette above a conical flask and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课：酸碱滴定。
